```python
alphabet = "fwphsmngyjraxbzdicqteuovkl"
words = [
    "highwaymen", "boyish", "antidisestablishmentarianism",
    "publications", "cutlet", "muscular", "musky", "leather",
    "synaptic", "paula", "astigmat", "zinc", "demonstrations",
    "godson", "creak", "heaven", "easternmost", "coriolanus",
    "scavenge", "individualization", "telecommunications",
]
submitted = [
    "astigmat", "antidisestablishmentarianism", "boyish", "creak",
    "cutlet", "coriolanus", "demonstrations", "easternmost",
    "godson", "heaven", "highwaymen", "individualization",
    "leather", "muscular", "musky", "paula", "publications",
    "scavenge", "synaptic", "telecommunications", "zinc",
]

assert len(alphabet) == 26 and set(alphabet) == set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
rank = {letter: index for index, letter in enumerate(alphabet)}
key = lambda word: tuple(rank[letter] for letter in word)
expected = sorted(words, key=key)

print("Expected:", ", ".join(expected))
print("Submitted:", ", ".join(submitted))

from collections import Counter
print("Word multiset matches:", Counter(words) == Counter(submitted))
for left, right in zip(submitted, submitted[1:]):
    if key(left) > key(right):
        print("Order violation:", left, "must come after", right)

print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
```
